decision.reason: This is the strongest current Hong Kong candidate for Australia-like betting frequency. It matches Australia V11 closely on completed-history bets/year, annual turnover, historical annual profit, ROI and A$10k maximum stake, but drawdown and live accepted-price evidence remain blockers.

historical.method: No rebate. Winning profit portion stressed 3% worse than research odds. Frozen sleeve stakes.

model.note: The calibrated model EV is the more conservative forward anchor. The much larger A$182,955 historical annual P/L is a historical stressed result, not a forward income promise.

risk.riskParityReason: HK same-race multi-runner exposure produced a materially deeper completed-history drawdown than Australia V11.

liveExecution.message: Fail closed. Do not place a Hong Kong bet until the frozen R2/Rvenue classifications, market rank/raw EV where required, executable WIN price and accepted stake are verified.

rejectedFrequencySearch.target: Approximately 50 bets/year while retaining Australia-like historical results
rejectedFrequencySearch.reason: Nearby 49–51 bet/year variants could be made to look strong on older completed history but deteriorated sharply in the newest 2026 partial evidence. The frozen 38.45 bet/year V2 is more defensible and already matches Australia V11's true 38.83 bet/year cadence almost exactly.

archivedR15.reasonArchived: Far too high-frequency for the requested Australia-like operating style and dependent on synthetic/proxy PLACE execution assumptions.

caveats: HK PARITY V2 is research/shadow only, not production-approved.
Historical HKJC research/closing prices plus a 3% adverse-price stress are not the same as verified live accepted bookmaker prices.
The A$182,955 annual historical figure is not a forward income forecast; the calibrated model EV anchor is materially lower at about A$42.7k/year.
The historical race-level max drawdown of about A$217k is materially worse than Australia V11 and remains the major risk blocker.
2026 is partial and must not be treated as a completed year.
Do not retune the frozen rule after future wins or losses simply to preserve backtest appearance.
